notes.text:
---
name: Large policy pages get persisted out of reach
description: Use when a fetched refund-policy page is huge (nav-heavy Shopify theme) and only a preview shows
type: reference
---
web_fetch on nav-heavy shops (e.g. kith.com/policies/refund-policy) can exceed the size limit; the output is saved to a file outside the workspace that read refuses, so the policy text is lost. Don't waste calls on /pages/returns or /pages/terms-of-sale (404 there). Try the same URL with a query like `?view=...` or the `.json`/`.atom` variants, or a different page (e.g. /policies/shipping-policy, a help/FAQ page), to get smaller text. Never guess the window or payer; report the gap.
